name: Molten Chains
body:
School evocation [fire, metal]; Level magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a fire-blackened link of chain)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 feet + 10 feet/level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The chain in your hand turns into a long length of red hot chains that shoot forth and wrap around the designated target. The target takes 2d6 fire damage and is pinned. A successful Reflex save negates the panned condition and reduces the damage to 1d6.

On subsequent rounds, a creature that failed their save may attempt to free themselves of the chains by either attempting an Escape Artist (DC 15 + your caster level) check or Strength check (DC 10 + your caster level).

Each round they attempt such a check, they take 2d6 fire damage. Any creature attempting to physically aid the target takes 1d6 fire damage in the round they aid.
